dedupe_keys.name: energy consumption and weather data collected continuously during a period of 29 months at challenger building france

description: Jessica MOUAWAD and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The collection spans 29 months of ten-minute energy readings at the Challenger building in France. Eight zones in its South Triangle have HVAC, lighting, plug, sanitary and blind-related electrical measurements, with air-handling and aggregate electrical consumption and VRF thermal energy. Weather variables have hourly or daily resolution and include temperature, humidity, radiation, rain and sunshine. The source supplies CSV time series and JSON metadata through a BEMServer BMS export. The dataset supports building-energy modelling and the related MPCA anomaly-detection application. Exact calendar dates are not stated. Derived ENERIT outputs can reuse these measurements and are documented separately. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cdla-permissive-1.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
